Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7199437. wordfreq includes data files that may be redistributed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). It contains data extracted from Google Books Ngrams (http://books.google.com/ngrams); data derived from the Leeds Internet Corpus, from the University of Leeds Centre for Translation Studies (http://corpus.leeds.ac.uk/list.html), Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia (http://www.wikipedia.org) and ParaCrawl (https://paracrawl.eu); data from OPUS OpenSubtitles 2018 (http://opus.nlpl.eu/OpenSubtitles.php), whose data originates from the OpenSubtitles project (http://www.opensubtitles.org/); and the SUBTLEX word lists (SUBTLEX-US, SUBTLEX-UK, SUBTLEX-CH, SUBTLEX-DE, SUBTLEX-NL) created by Marc Brysbaert et al., freely available at http://crr.ugent.be/programs-data/subtitle-frequencies.
